admission.justification: Spans composition layers: retaining each authored choice's provider/model binding and explaining incompatible lower choices as non-applicable (never reinterpreted) keeps FAM-N17BB4's carried choices faithful per layer.

applicability: Every composition of authored settings layers that carries provider/model bindings.
conditions: Both the higher and the lower layer author a choice for the same slot.
Composition runs through the existing loader.
exclusions: Reinterpretation of a lower choice for a higher-layer provider.
Presentation-only omission text, which carries no binding.
statement: Layer composition retains the provider/model binding of each authored choice; an incompatible lower choice is explained as non-applicable rather than reinterpreted for a higher-layer provider.
